free-model-check.template: Run the free-model health check: confirm the resolved default model is kilo/kilo-auto/free, run `opencode providers list --pure`, verify only the allowlisted providers (kilo, opencode, groq, google, mistral, huggingface) resolve, smoke-test the default model with `opencode run --format json`, and report any non-zero cost, missing key, or unavailable provider. Do not use or suggest paid models.
